What gets in the way today

{{icon:circle-alert}}

Opaque unlisted financials

High-growth private companies have no public reporting obligations, so verifying their numbers before an NDA is difficult.

{{icon:circle-alert}}

Cap table uncertainty

Pitch deck equity figures often differ from official share allotment filings, hiding dilution or undisclosed preference shares.

{{icon:circle-alert}}

High platform overhead

Per-seat licences for huge company databases are expensive when you only need deep diligence on 10 to 20 deals a year.
